name: F731U-F731USQS8GZF1 to dm3q-S918BXXSAFZH3 tuned profile
comment: New AFZH3 payload derived from the validated POC. It preserves the validated boot quiet window and P-select timing, while reducing the default run to one attempt, using 45 s for P0, 60 s for the attempt, and polling the supervisor every 10 ms.

byte_patches.comment: remove the high half of the old 100 ms delay
